items.title: FBI warns of Kali365 PhaaS harvesting M365 OAuth tokens via device-code flow
items.source_name: CSIRT / FBI PSA + The Hacker News
items.impact_target: High; persistent M365 account takeover, MFA fully bypassed via token capture
items.summary: The FBI issued a PSA on Kali365, a phishing-as-a-service kit sold on Telegram for as little as $250/month that captures Microsoft 365 OAuth tokens through the legitimate device-code authentication flow. A related year-long device-code campaign logged 218 distinct accounts (~94% corporate mailboxes) between June 2025 and July 2026.

items.title: Misconfigured server exposes three Evilginx operations targeting Microsoft 365
items.impact_target: High; AiTM session-token theft on M365, then BEC and account takeover
items.summary: A misconfigured attacker server revealed three separate phishing operations getting past MFA two mechanically different ways — proxying the live Microsoft login (Evilginx AiTM) and abusing the device-code sign-in flow — each requiring different defenses.

items.title: EvilTokens PhaaS: OAuth-consent phishing compromised 340+ M365 orgs
items.impact_target: High; consent-layer takeover across 340+ orgs in 5 countries in 5 weeks
items.summary: EvilTokens (live since Feb 2026) abuses the OAuth consent screen — a click credential-phishing controls do not inspect — to seize persistent app tokens and bypass MFA entirely; 340+ Microsoft 365 organizations hit within five weeks of launch.

items.title: Storm-2603 deploys Warlock ransomware via SharePoint RCE CVE-2026-45659
items.source_name: CISA KEV / Microsoft MSTIC + The Hacker News
items.impact_target: High; on-prem SharePoint compromise -> Warlock ransomware + double extortion
items.summary: The group behind the 2025 ToolShell SharePoint campaign, Storm-2603 (GOLD SALEM, linked by Microsoft to China-based activity), is exploiting on-prem SharePoint RCE CVE-2026-45659 to deploy Warlock ransomware — a repeat of its 2025 on-prem-SharePoint-to-Warlock playbook. CISA KEV-listed Jul 1, 2026.

items.title: Qilin leads July surge with AI-driven data-theft extortion; Genesis claims 9 victims/24h
items.impact_target: High; multi-sector orgs able to pay, double-extortion with data theft
items.summary: Ransomware.live and CYFIRMA's weekly tracker show Qilin leading early-July activity (AI-assisted operations, data-theft extortion) with Genesis claiming 9 victims in 24h on Jul 5 and The Gentlemen among the most active groups this window.

items.title: FortiBleed stolen-credential campaign feeds INC and Lynx ransomware at 12+ orgs
items.impact_target: High; VPN/firewall foothold converted directly to ransomware deployment
items.summary: ~20 actors under the 'FortiBleed' banner used 74,000 stolen FortiGate firewall/VPN credentials (advertised in June), brute force, and config dumping to break password hashes; the access has already been converted into ransomware at 12+ organizations via the INC and Lynx operations.

items.title: DOJ sentences Florida ransomware negotiator who secretly extorted his own clients
items.impact_target: Insider-threat angle; five victims paid $213K-$26.8M ($75M+ total)
items.summary: A 41-year-old former ransomware negotiator was sentenced to 70 months for conspiring with BlackCat/ALPHV actors to extort victims he was ostensibly helping; five DigitalMint clients paid ransoms totalling more than $75M between April and September 2023.

items.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server RCE CVE-2026-45659 under active exploitation (on CISA KEV)
items.source_name: CISA KEV / Microsoft MSTIC + The Hacker News
items.impact_target: Very high; RCE on internet-facing on-prem SharePoint, used as a network-staging foothold
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-45659 (CVSS 8.8; a low-privilege authenticated RCE in on-prem SharePoint Server) to the KEV catalog on Jul 1, 2026 with a 3-day federal patch deadline (Jul 4). Microsoft had rated exploitation 'less likely' in its May updates, but active exploitation began ~6 weeks later. Remediation: apply the May 2026 updates (KB5002863/68/70), prioritising internet-facing servers.

items.title: Joomla iCagenda & Balbooa Forms zero-days added to CISA KEV (arbitrary file upload RCE)
items.impact_target: Very high; unauth file upload -> PHP code execution on internet-facing Joomla sites
items.summary: CISA added two max-severity Joomla flaws to the KEV catalog after zero-day exploitation: CVE-2026-48939 (iCagenda arbitrary file upload -> PHP code exec, abused since Jun 15, 2026 in automated attacks) and CVE-2026-56291 (Balbooa Forms upload -> RCE). Related Joomla builder flaws (JoomShaper CVE-2026-48908, Joomlack CVE-2026-56290) followed.

items.title: FortiSandbox unauth RCE CVE-2026-39808 / -39813 (CVSS 9.8) under active exploitation
items.impact_target: Very high; unauthenticated RCE on an internet-exposed security appliance
items.summary: Two CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated RCE flaws in FortiSandbox (CVE-2026-39808 and CVE-2026-39813), part of Fortinet's 27-vulnerability advisory batch, are now under active exploitation; ~2,000 FortiClient EMS instances remain exposed to the public internet.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler 'CitrixBleed' CVE-2026-8451 exploited within 24h of disclosure
items.impact_target: Very high; session-token/memory disclosure on internet-facing NetScaler ADC/Gateway
items.summary: A new Citrix NetScaler memory-disclosure flaw dubbed 'CitrixBleed' (CVE-2026-8451) was exploited in the wild within 24 hours of its June 30 disclosure, letting attackers lift session tokens from internet-facing ADC/Gateway devices and bypass authentication.

items.title: 17 fake payment SDKs on npm & PyPI harvest CI/CD secrets to an ngrok C2
items.impact_target: Very high; one install reaches CI/CD, cloud, and developer secrets
items.summary: On Jul 7, 2026 a threat actor published 17 malicious packages (13 npm + 4 PyPI) impersonating Paysafe, Skrill, and Neteller SDKs. Each harvested API keys, AWS credentials, GitHub/npm tokens, and secret-looking env vars, exfiltrating to a C2 hidden behind an ngrok tunnel; sandbox-evasion checks bailed on <2 CPU cores. Detected malicious within ~6 minutes of publication.

items.title: 'Shai-Hulud' self-propagating worm hits 170+ npm & PyPI packages again
items.impact_target: Very high; worm-style spread through dependency graphs, secret harvesting at install
items.summary: A fresh Shai-Hulud wave compromised 170+ packages across npm and PyPI, harvesting secrets during install and re-publishing itself through maintainers' own tokens to spread — the same worm pattern that hit the ecosystem earlier in 2026, now recurring.

items.title: Salesloft Drift OAuth token theft (UNC6395 'Icarus') drains 700+ Salesforce tenants
items.impact_target: Very high; SaaS data + embedded plaintext AWS/Snowflake/VPN credentials across 700+ orgs
items.summary: Between Jun 8-18, 2026 attackers used OAuth tokens issued to the Salesloft Drift app to reach 700+ Salesforce customer instances via API and systematically export support cases, contacts, and — critically — plaintext AWS keys, Snowflake tokens, and VPN credentials embedded in that data. Microsoft has since mapped three Salesforce attack paths tied to a year of ShinyHunters activity.

items.title: Klue integration breach exposes Salesforce CRM data via stolen OAuth tokens
items.impact_target: Medium-to-high; CRM data theft through a trusted third-party connector
items.summary: On Jun 12, 2026 attackers used a compromised legacy integration credential to obtain OAuth tokens connecting Klue to Salesforce and other platforms, then pulled customer CRM data; Salesforce disabled the Klue integration in response. The Icarus group, active since April 2026, is behind it.

items.title: Langflow authorization-bypass CVE-2026-55255 added to CISA KEV (agentic AI builder)
items.impact_target: High; auth bypass on an internet-exposed low-code AI/agent-building platform
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-55255, an Authorization-Bypass-Through-User-Controlled-Key flaw in Langflow (a popular low-code framework for building LLM/agent workflows), to the KEV catalog after active exploitation — a reminder that the AI tooling layer itself is now internet-facing attack surface.

items.title: Unit 42 confirms indirect prompt injection weaponized in the wild; coding agents fall >85%
items.impact_target: High; a hijacked tool-enabled agent inherits its tools (email, code, DB, browse)
items.summary: Unit 42 documented 22 distinct attacker techniques and confirmed active indirect-prompt-injection (IPI) weaponization in the wild. A review of 78 studies found every major coding agent fell to prompt injection, with adaptive attacks landing >85% of the time; OWASP reports 73% of live AI rollouts have prompt-injection-exposed flaws and only ~35% have specific defenses.

items.title: MCP server exploits: MCPJam Inspector RCE CVE-2026-23744 (9.8); GitHub MCP data exfil
items.impact_target: High; RCE on agent tooling and private-repo exfil via poisoned MCP inputs
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol layer is now a live target: CVE-2026-23744 gave attackers RCE on MCPJam Inspector (CVSS 9.8), a booby-trapped PDF tripped a physical pump via a Claude MCP link, and attackers abused GitHub's MCP server to exfiltrate private repository data through malicious issues — the harness/tooling seam, not the model, is the weak point.
